html:
SMTO-EXE-0208 — That page number isn't in this PDF

GUID: 4e3007d9-7da5-58eb-864e-486c542c2a15
Slug: pdf-page-out-of-range
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to use a page the PDF doesn't have, for example page 12 of a 10-page file. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO how many pages the PDF has. Knowing the real page count shows which page numbers are valid.
  2. Ask again using page numbers from 1 up to that count. The first page is page 1, not page 0. Any page number below 1 or above the last page is rejected.
  3. When inserting pages, say "at the start" or name a page that exists in the file to insert after. You can't insert after a page the document doesn't have.
  4. If the PDF was edited or replaced recently, ask for the page count again before choosing pages. A changed file may have fewer pages than before.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the action on the pages you chose.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the page numbers you asked for, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A requested PDF page was not an integer from 1 to the document's page count, or an insertion position (after_page) was beyond the last page.

What this means

  • A requested page was noninteger, below one or beyond the current page count, or an insertion position exceeded the document's end. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • A requested page was noninteger, below one or beyond the current page count, or an insertion position exceeded the document's end.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the supplied one-based pages or insertion position with current pdf.info/pages metadata.

How to fix it

  • Read pdf.info or pdf.pages to get the current page_count and use 1-based page numbers within it; insert_pages after_page must be between 0 (start) and the page count, and form_field_create page must exist. The file may have changed since its page count was last read.
  • Read pdf.pages or pdf.info and select existing 1-based pages.

Retry and execution caution

  • Read pdf.pages or pdf.info and select existing 1-based pages.

How to verify the fix

  • All selected pages and insertion positions exist in the reviewed current source.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
